## Wave 6 Summary

This wave executes the S100a landscape-synthesis §V batch note: one single-shot bridge-landing wave batching SIX §VII-adjacent registry entries (gates W6-1 … W6-6: two exact/structural-theorem landings + four STAGE-1-CANDIDATE registrations), ONE permanence-ledger line (W6-8), ONE canonical-constants promotion with version-disambiguation sub-keying (W6-7), and ONE mack-cosmic-bridge sole-writer dispatch slot (W6-9, routing spec — not a gate any non-mack agent executes). Every registry-writing gate uses the single-shot AFTER pattern of `computations/_bridge_landing_script_template.py` per `registry-landing.md` §"Bridge-Landing Script Architecture": `build_promotion_text` (pure, in-memory) → `write_atomic_with_fsync` (append) → `re_read + verify_section_matches` (single boolean) → emit ONCE (script prints the payload via `print_verdict_payload`; the agent calls `emit_verdict`). The BEFORE pattern (write → verify → conditional corrective re-write → second emission) is FORBIDDEN; a verify-FAIL emits FAIL once and the gate closes honestly per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md`. The carry-forward sources are the S100a/S100b housekeeping §B/§D ledgers, the four S100a workshops' frozen texts, and the three solo syntheses (binding-text rule: canonical specs are transcribed/extracted, never re-derived).

**Substrate framing (wave-level)**: the six entries register what the spectral triple `(A_K, H_K, D_K)` has already proven about itself — an exact operator-commutator identity on the multiplicity bundle (W6-1), a closed-form Haar-moment generation lever (W6-2), the state-pair-metric generation-resolution theorem complex (W6-3), the fixed-backbone H-parity drive-exclusion wall (W6-4), the 4-of-64 KK spinor-reduction lemma behind the exact √16 gravitational normalization (W6-5), and the band-selective Schur-rigidity no-go (W6-6). The direction of explanation in every promotion text flows D_K eigenvalues → spectral moments → emergent observable; no landing inverts it.

**PD-2 — Runtime next-free-letter scan discipline (every landing script).** Each producing script re-scans `sessions/permanent-results-registry.md` at runtime for slot occupancy covering **ALL header levels** (`## §VII.x` + `### §VII.x` + `#### §VII.x`) per `epistemic-discipline.md` §"Registry-Write Hygiene under Parallel-Writer Race" item 1 (a one-hash-level scan under-counts; the §VII.BK rerouting precedent). The script confirms its planned slot is RESERVED to it in the lockfile AND free on disk.

**PD-3 — Runtime occupancy ⇒ reroute + FAIL-with-remediation.** If the reserved slot is occupied at runtime (an intervening landing), the script reroutes to the next-free-letter AND the verdict line emits **FAIL-with-remediation** (NOT PASS) so the rerouting is visible in the audit trail, per `epistemic-discipline.md` §"Registry-Write Hygiene" item 3. The rerouted landing itself may be textually complete; the FAIL records the slot drift.

**PD-4 — Single-writer serialization of the registry chain.** Gates W6-1 → W6-2 → W6-3 → W6-4 → W6-5 → W6-6 → W6-8 ALL append to `sessions/permanent-results-registry.md` and therefore execute **SEQUENTIALLY in that order** (one writer at a time; raw appends are not atomic across processes on Windows — the same rationale as `emit_verdict`). W6-7 (canonical_constants.py surface) may run in parallel with the registry chain (disjoint file). W6-9 (mack dispatch) fires only AFTER the W6-1…W6-8 chain completes (its four surfaces are disjoint from the registry, but the T1–T5/A1–A3 register drafts touch register files whose cross-references cite the W6 landings — sequence-after avoids dangling cites).

**PD-5 — Per-landing script (no sharing).** Pre-registered choice (documenting the batching freedom the source CF left open): **each landing gate gets its OWN producing script** — gates W6-1, W6-2, and W6-8 do NOT share a script. Rationale: the AFTER pattern's single-point-of-emission is per-gate; a shared script couples FAIL modes across independent landings (a build failure in one gate's text would block the others' honest verdicts) and complicates the per-gate-distinct `audit_sha256` discipline (sig_5). One script, one landing, one canonical verdict line + one dual-SHA companion row.

## W6-9 (routing block, no gate-§ prefix by design) — mack-cosmic-bridge sole-writer dispatch slot

**This block is a ROUTING specification, not an R3 gate.** No verdict line, no producing script, no YAML gate block. It is executed as ONE `mack-cosmic-bridge` dispatch by the orchestrator; `mack-cosmic-bridge` is the SOLE WRITER of every surface named below per `feedback_mack-bridge-role.md` — neither gen-physicist nor any other W6 agent touches these files. Fires AFTER the W6-1…W6-8 chain completes (PD-4).

**Dispatch payload (two batched work items, one dispatch)**:
